description_en: Calls this operation to verify domain name ownership
description_zh: 调用本接口验证域名归属权
kebab_example: aliyun vod verify-vod-domain-owner --domain-name example.com --verify-type dnsCheck --region cn-hangzhou
name: VerifyVodDomainOwner

parameters.description_en: The domain name to verify. Only a single domain name can be verified at a time.
parameters.description_zh: 校验的域名。仅支持单域名校验。
parameters.help_en: The domain name to verify. Only a single domain name can be verified at a time

parameters.description_en:
The domain name ownership verification method. Valid values:

- **dnsCheck**: DNS resolution verification.
- **fileCheck**: File verification.

- **fileCheck**：文件验证。
